A Media Archaeology of Digital Language

Artificial Languages

Every communication technology has its own architecture, shaping and limiting how we communicate. It challenges our belief in language as a natural, transparent medium for conveying meaning, emotion, and truth.

Yet people creatively push beyond these limits, inventing digital languages that exceed both the conventions of natural language and the technology’s original purposes. Far from being imperfect substitutes, these languages open up new possibilities for expression, play, and intimacy.

Choose a mode and talk with the chatbot. Explore how technology shapes language, and how new forms of intimacy emerge.

LOVE MACHINE

Meet BARI, a fictional K-pop idol voiced by AI, through three technologies of fandom. BARI belongs to a group, loves joking around, and calls fans BOTTARI (보따리, a bundle wrapped in cloth), the name of the official fan club. Pick a technology and join in.

Every fan here, and everything they remember about you, is fictional and generated in this browser session. Nothing is saved after you end LOVE MACHINE.

End LOVE MACHINE? All conversations with BARI will be cleared, and next time you will start fresh.

BARI is a fictional idol voiced by AI, not a real person. You are a member of BOTTARI (“every day”), BARI's fan club.

Decode appears under replies in every mode except Generative AI. It reveals meaning and mechanism, and keeps three kinds of expression apart:

  • documented a historically documented Korean digital expression
  • adaptation an English equivalent or adaptation of a convention
  • experimental a new expression the AI invented

An artistic experiment inspired by Korean digital language history. Every reply is generated live by Claude; English adaptations are not exact translations, and the AI's labels can be wrong. In pager mode, any code not on the reference list is marked with * and labelled experimental automatically.
